permit.applies: The employer submits the request, in writing and before the work starts, to the Department of Labour and Employment of the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare, with the foreigner's stay permit or valid visa and the job's details; for work of less than three months an employment permit is issued instead.
permit.first: A stay permit under the Law on Foreigners (or a valid visa); the permit is refused where the labour market situation does not allow the employment, or the yearly number of permits the Government sets is filled.

sources.title: Law No. 03/L-136 on Granting Permit for Work and Employment of Foreign Citizens in the Republic of Kosovo (copy held by the Kosovo Police)
sources.said: Natural persons, who are not citizens of Kosovo, when willing to work in the territory of Republic of Kosovo for a timeframe of less than three (3) months, shall be granted the employment permit issued by the Ministry of Labor and Social Welfare. … the work permit of type B go for a yearly period ; 1.4. this work permit type can be renovated for a yearly period … The request for getting a work permit shall be submitted in written form before starting the work … the situation of work in Kosovo market does not allow this employment regulated with sub- legal act … Together with the request for work permit, employer is obliged to submit: 1.1. the document for stay permit in the Republic of Kosovo, or proof for possessing official valid visa. … The deadline for approving or refusing request for work permit is no more than thirty (30) days since the complete documents are submitted to the competent body.

blockers.sought: Whether Law No. 03/L-136 still governs, or a newer Law on Foreigners (draft No. 08/L-296, proposed March 2024; press of March 2026 reports the Law on Foreigners' new entry rules both coming into force and postponed) has replaced its work permit
